prompts.town:
Create a production sprite sheet for the dark fantasy isometric ARPG Embergrave. 12 DIFFERENT full-body NPC character sprites, exactly four equal columns and 3 equal rows, read left to right then next row. Square 1536x1536. Fully transparent alpha background, each person isolated with generous transparent space between cells. No backdrop, tile, labels, writing, frames, cast ground shadows or contact oval. Neutral standing relaxed pose facing three-quarter toward the viewer, same isometric camera elevated 30 degrees. Semi-realistic detailed painted game art, grounded worn medieval materials, adult proportions, distinct faces and outfits visible at small scale. Full bodies including headgear and boots entirely inside cells. Children visibly shorter. No repeated characters, no repeated generic robe template. Each person's clothing colors, hair, gender, build and tools must distinguish their silhouette. Clothing appropriate to autumn medieval market town.
Sprites in strict reading order:
1. Captain Vessa Marn, stern middle-aged woman with dark cropped hair, bronze-trimmed steel breastplate and red sash, one hand on sword hilt.
2. Korrin the Smith, broad older man with bald crown and bushy black beard, heavy leather apron and hammer.
3. Old Maesa, stooped elderly white-haired woman in sage robes, herb basket and wooden cane.
4. Guardsman Brom, tall lean male veteran with grey moustache, kettle helmet, green tabard and spear.
5. Widow Lysa, dark-haired woman with braided bun, faded violet dress, white shawl and bread basket.
6. Pip, short red-haired boy in patched ochre tunic, bare head and wooden toy sword.
7. Drover Hask, stocky grizzled male drover wearing a brown wide-brim hat and olive coat, coiled rope.
8. Iona, young dark-skinned female refugee, blue headscarf, rust dress, folded blanket.
9. Tamsin, short blonde girl in blue pinafore over cream clothes, carrying a small cloth doll.
10. Jory, slender male smith apprentice with curly brown hair, rolled white sleeves, soot apron and tongs.
11. Rafe, shaved-headed dark-skinned off-duty male soldier, red quilted vest, round shield on back.
12. Merrit, elderly fisherwoman with grey braid, moss-green coat, wicker creel and short fishing rod.

Soft overhead lighting, strong readable shape, natural skin tones. No scene or other objects outside each person's own clothing and held tools.
prompts.frosthaven:

Square 1536x1536. Fully transparent alpha background, each person isolated with generous transparent space between cells. Full bodies including headgear and boots entirely inside cells. Children visibly shorter. No repeated characters, no repeated generic robe template.
